snippet.title: Wingspan - Asia Expansion Announcement Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP2723-PPSA20773_00-WINGSPAN0EU0PS5D

Wingspan: Asia Expansion is coming this Summer!

Across the lands of the East, from ancient peaks shrouded by mists, to quiet oases whispering timeless secrets... life takes wing!

Wingspan arrives on a new continent in Wingspan: Asia Expansion. Discover the mysterious, diverse birds of the East along with their enchanting world. Here, you’ll encounter new bird and bonus cards, expand your collection of backgrounds and portraits with beautiful new ones inspired by the region, and have the opportunity to play in an all-new Duet Mode that will bring a breath of fresh air and even more variety to your games.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #wingspan
